data.one_liner: A sliding tutorial widget with parallax effects for app onboarding.
data.what_it_does: Provides a sliding tutorial library with applied parallax effects to create product presentations and onboarding flows similar to Google apps tutorials.
use_when: You are building an onboarding or tutorial sequence for your app
You want to incorporate parallax effects into a slide presentation
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose page slider or carousel without tutorial-specific parallax
You are using a state management or navigation framework that conflicts with standard widget trees
strengths: Adds pre-built parallax effects for smoother product presentations
Easy setup for sliding onboarding flows
weaknesses: Limited to tutorial and onboarding use cases
Documentation relies heavily on external wiki links
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package in your Dart code.

alternatives.name: animations
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard Material motion and transition patterns instead of a dedicated onboarding slider.

data.minimal_example:
import 'package:flutter_sliding_tutorial/flutter_sliding_tutorial.dart';

// Add flutter_sliding_tutorial to pubspec.yaml dependencies
